what_is_closed: Lossless numeric image export with source-byte identity
Common and pairwise masks with support-sensitivity diagnostic
equation_or_mapping: R(t)=sum_ON(mask)/sum_OFF(mask); baseline mean removed separately for each fixed mask rule
